Reference images are actual current Gyro browser-fixture captures; use them as visual design-system and component grounding, NOT as an edit target. Keep the existing product identity. Improve only the working-process components requested below.
Canvas 1440 x 1024, landscape. A focused component design review sheet, not an entire app inventory. Use a cropped chat transcript at its natural 760px column width centered within the frame, with a small quiet title top-left and tiny footer "Gyro · Design proposal". No device frames, perspective, giant headings, glassmorphism, gradients, glows, decorative backgrounds, unrelated dashboards, invented navigation, oversized cards, or unnecessary badges.
Actual Gyro dark tokens: canvas/pane #1c1c1c, subtle surfaces #222222 and #252525, raised #2b2b2b, primary text #ededed, secondary #b5b5b5, faint #a0a0a0; hairlines white 5.5% to 9%; SF/system sans for UI, SF Mono/Menlo for commands and paths. Typography body14–16px, work/support13px, metadata12px at intended UI scale; render sharply and readable. Corners4px controls,6–8px utility surfaces,18px composer only. Blue #60b0ff is action/focus; amber #f4bf5a waiting/retry; pink-red #ff8995 failures; green #5ed8a4 confirmed successful results only. Keep completed activity neutral. Never use semantic color as decoration.
Shared proposed component language: one steady run header; chronological work aligned on a quiet fine vertical hairline, compact outline icons, completed operations muted, current operation brighter; details hidden behind chevrons until needed. Narration remains natural text, clearly separated from compact technical rows. Prefer spacing, alignment, and typography before borders, then thin dividers, then subtle surfaces. Strong action hierarchy, at most one primary action in a given state. Keep readable spacing without excess empty acreage.
Use only real capabilities described below. All displayed paths, counts, timings and messages are illustrative sample content, not evidence of a live task. Do not invent provider progress percentages, time estimates, safety claims, saved-state guarantees, costs or token totals. If dates appear, today is November 7, 2026 (Europe/Amsterdam), but prefer no calendar dates.
Make ONE coherent design treatment, not three competing options. Render all specified text cleanly with no accidental duplicate labels or gibberish.

Sheet title: Plan ready to implement
Specific component brief:
One focused cropped chat with a small existing plan summary and composer-replacing decision dock. Quiet heading 'Implementation plan', a simple three-item numbered plan 'Trace the retry loop', 'Add a five-attempt limit', 'Run the retry tests'. These are planned steps, not completed checks. Dock header 'Implement this plan?' with secondary '3 steps · Switches to Normal mode' and X labelled visually as 'Keep planning' if space. Primary keyboard option row '1' 'Yes, implement this plan', secondary 'Gyro works through the steps and checks them off as it goes.' Inline arrow, blue focus border, restrained styling. Feedback field 'Keep planning… tell Gyro what to change' and send-arrow action. Tiny footer 'Enter implement · Esc keep planning'. No permission bypass promise: plan approval is distinct from command/file approvals. Under divider one smaller pending-state specimen same option 'Starting…', controls visually disabled; not another active CTA. Keep plan and dock integrated in existing chat, no kanban, no new project wizard.
